title: Finite Nash Equilibria and Dependent Mixed Strategies in Lean
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We present two complementary Lean 4 developments of finite Nash equilibrium. The pure-game layer uses player-specific legal action sets, distinguishes one-way generalized ordinal potentials from bidirectional ordinal potentials, and proves potential-maximizer certificates, a local-maximum characterization, absence of strict-improvement cycles, and weak acyclicity. The mixed-game layers use either a common finite action type or a dependent finite action type for each player.
